target.title: fix(github-copilot): prevent stale encrypted reasoning failures
target.body:
fix #95441

Related: #95493
Related: #95587

AI-assisted: yes (GitHub Copilot).

## What Problem This Solves

Persisted GitHub Copilot reasoning can become invalid when OpenClaw reconstructs a session, causing `invalid_encrypted_content` or a missing reply on a later turn. The rejection can happen while creating a Responses request or after its SSE stream opens.

## Why This Change Was Made

The fix uses the existing owner boundaries:

- **Cold replay history:** the GitHub Copilot provider's `sanitizeReplayHistory` hook removes persisted thinking/reasoning when a Copilot Responses `AgentSession` is rehydrated. The sanitized history becomes that session's in-memory state, while reasoning generated later in the same agent/tool loop remains available.
- **Active wire payload:** the provider boundary preserves complete native `rs_*` reasoning, converts Copilot connection-bound reasoning IDs to idless replay, keeps already-idless reasoning, and removes foreign, malformed, or incomplete reasoning. Existing message/function-call ID normalization remains intact.
- **Single bounded recovery:** Responses request creation and SSE draining share one retry budget. Before any public model output, a recognized encrypted-content failure retries once after removing only the top-level `encrypted_content` field from reasoning items. The retry preserves reasoning summaries and IDs, assistant messages, function calls, function outputs, and their order. Requests containing compaction fail closed instead of dropping compaction or constructing an item without its required ciphertext.

This separates prevention from recovery because neither is sufficient alone. Applying only a broad replay policy would discard valid same-loop continuity; relying only on recovery would keep sending known-stale state and make provider failure part of the normal path. Provider-owned cold sanitation plus one bounded generic fallback avoids both without adding session state, configuration, or a compatibility path.

The change adds no configuration, persisted replay state, transcript mutation, or public SDK surface.

## User Impact

Rehydrated Copilot sessions no longer send persisted opaque reasoning. Valid same-loop reasoning and tool continuation remain available. If a provider rejects stale reasoning before output starts, recovery preserves the continuation structure; compaction remains untouched and fails closed.

## Upstream Behavior References

- [`@github/copilot@1.0.69-2`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@github/copilot/v/1.0.69-2), build `546d22a58d`: active history retains encrypted reasoning, while cold resume, abort/cancel, and effective-model history rewrite strip opaque reasoning.
- [`github/copilot-sdk@5adb51b`](https://github.com/github/copilot-sdk/blob/5adb51b9e2ac50ad4876e756fa8c05549c1490fd/nodejs/src/generated/session-events.ts#L1044-L1054) documents OpenAI encrypted reasoning as session-bound and stripped on resume.
- [`microsoft/vscode@47657de`](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/blob/47657deafbdff06ea10cc8c993967f6b42cd5bf8/extensions/copilot/src/platform/endpoint/node/responsesApi.ts#L145-L172) requests `reasoning.encrypted_content`; its [history selection](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/blob/47657deafbdff06ea10cc8c993967f6b42cd5bf8/extensions/copilot/src/platform/endpoint/node/responsesApi.ts#L306-L395) excludes pre-marker history, and its [serializer](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/blob/47657deafbdff06ea10cc8c993967f6b42cd5bf8/extensions/copilot/src/platform/endpoint/node/responsesApi.ts#L631-L660) replays only complete Responses reasoning.
- OpenAI Node `6.45.0` models reasoning ciphertext as optional while compaction ciphertext is required; the recovery path therefore strips only reasoning ciphertext and never mutates compaction.
- #72602 records the live Copilot CAPI matrix: exact original or omitted reasoning IDs are accepted with original ciphertext; synthetic reasoning IDs are rejected.

## Evidence

- Current exact head: `01b6e5fb8a33ce42ea2c3294817dd5b07bc8d8f3`; 8 files, `+798/-241`.
- Builder-driven Responses continuation proof passed 57 tests, including create-time and streamed rejection, response-ID reset, one shared retry budget, abort/output-start guards, preservation of reasoning/message/function-call/function-output order, unchanged ID-only reasoning, and compaction create/drain fail-closed behavior.
- GitHub Copilot connection-bound-ID and stream-wrapper proof passed 15 tests. The focused cold-resume provider integration passed (1 test; 30 unrelated tests skipped).
- Targeted Oxfmt and Oxlint passed for all 8 PR files; `git diff --check` passed.
- Full local tsgo/aggregate lint was blocked by this linked worktree's stale dependency install missing existing `@types/web-push`; no dependency files are changed. Exact-head GitHub CI is running for the current commit.
- The primary cold-resume behavior was previously credentialed-live-tested on the unchanged provider sanitation path: one visible reply, `invalid_encrypted_content = 0`, and `LLM request failed = 0`. The current retry-only follow-up has no local Copilot credential, so that reactive fallback remains an explicit live-proof gap.
- Current-main manual review found no remaining actionable issue after replacing the destructive retry. The prior P1 path that removed reasoning/compaction while retaining tool continuation no longer exists.
